architecture_findings: Source discovery and assessment are independently dispatched by Watchdog and exchange a typed immutable artifact with exact run/head provenance.
Both source capabilities write only to isolated RUNNER_TEMP artifact roots; the main-branch source documents are read-only baselines.
Assessment's only shared mutation is the per-URL task checkpoint in GitHub Issue #315, guarded by task lease and logical resource fences.
The production publish workflow stages and commits rulesets/** only; modules/uu.conf and all non-ruleset repository paths remain outside the publish allowlist.
Other non-dispatchable Python capabilities retain default-deny status until their own complete transitive side-effect and resource contracts are reviewed.
decomposition_constraints: Preserve the audit -> publish dependency and the existing single-writer concurrency boundary.
A capability can run alone only after its input snapshot, output artifacts, dependencies, resource leases, timeout/retry, idempotency and independent verifier are implemented.
The publish job must not be decomposed into independently writable capability jobs without a single controlled publisher.
The review cursor recovery job runs only after audit failure and must remain a recovery path.
Dashboard generation is observer-only and is not a production stage.

review_context.note: Updated against the scoped source DAG candidate: runner-local immutable artifacts, external predecessor digest binding, and no repository publication from source assessment. Remaining global audit applies to other non-dispatchable capabilities.

duplicate_protection.rule: When SOURCE_DISCOVERY_MODE=independent, auto_sync's monolithic discovery and assessment steps are skipped; the Watchdog-owned independent producer and its exact workflow_run consumer are the sole discovery/assessment path. The monolithic steps remain only as explicit fallback when mode is monolithic_fallback.
